name: LDAR (lay down and rot)

lead: LDAR means 'lay down and rot': giving up on dating, social life and improvement. It comes from incel and blackpill forums.
It is a mantra of hopelessness rather than a method.

paras: It follows from the belief that looks and genetics determine outcomes, so effort is considered pointless.
Research on incel communities reports loneliness, hopelessness and talk of suicide, though samples are self-selected. Support resources for people struggling exist outside these forums.

lead: LDAR, short for 'lay down and rot' (Grokipedia spells it 'lie down and rot'), is slang in incel and blackpill communities for resignation: giving up on dating, social life or self-improvement. [1][2]

Wikipedia lists LDAR among common mantras in incel culture that reflect hopelessness. [2] Studies of incel communities describe hopelessness, self-pity and discussion of suicide, though most research relies on self-selected samples. [2][1]
No studies of the term itself were found.
infobox: Resignation, withdrawal from dating and social life

paras: Grokipedia defines LDAR as a term for resignation and withdrawal from dating and social life. [1] Wikipedia describes it as a common incel mantra that reflects hopelessness. [2]
The idea follows from the blackpill premise that looks and genetics fix outcomes. If self-improvement is regarded as futile or 'cope', LDAR is the logical response in these communities' terms. [1][2]

Wikipedia reports that studies identify loneliness and isolation as key aspects of inceldom and that the community is associated with hopelessness, self-pity and talk of suicide. [2] A 2022 review emphasises that the majority of incels have not engaged in violence and that their experiences of rejection and mental-health problems deserve attention.
A study of people leaving inceldom analysed turning points that prompted deradicalisation from forum threads on r/IncelExit.
